name: ASPCA Trap Bank
region_note: TRAP BANKS / HUMANE TRAP LENDING (borrow a trap to start TNR)
notes: The ASPCA rents traps, dividers and carriers to TNR-certified rescuers who have an ASPCA Terms of Use Agreement on file. Book through the Rescuer Services Scheduler or by email to TNRtrapbank@aspca.org; pick-up and return Mon-Fri 10:30am-3pm in East New York, Brooklyn; keep for 14 days. The page says the ASPCA is taking on new rescue partners in Los Angeles and Miami, not New York, so this is for rescuers who already have an account. Everyone else: see the other trap banks in the TNR guide.
